name: suggested-prompts
summary: Ready-made things to ask an AI — chips for follow-ups under an answer, cards for starters on an empty page, a list in a narrow panel. Picking one fills the composer; it never sends.
useWhen: An AI page is empty and people need a first thing to ask.
An answer has natural next questions worth offering.

alternatives.name: command
alternatives.when: people pick from a long, searchable list of actions.

alternatives.name: button
alternatives.when: the choice runs an action straight away instead of filling the composer.

rules.do: Fill the composer and focus it, so people can edit before sending.
rules.dont: Send the suggestion the moment it is clicked — people lose the chance to adjust it.

rules.do: Use chips under an answer, cards on an empty AI page, and the list in a narrow panel.
rules.dont: Put large starter cards under every answer — they crowd the thread.

a11y: A labelled list of buttons; each button's text is the suggestion, so it reads well out of context.
